title: Bound Codex worker and subagent context: no forked history, no unused tools
body:
Outcome: Codex subagents start without the parent's history (podolog forks 113-292k, rea 64k) and receive a pointer brief; KRN worker runs disable web search and image generation (about 3.2k per run) via the delegate-codex codex-worker config list.
Evidence: .krn/runs/context-audit/codex.md drains 2 and 3.
Proof (KRN-12): measured first-turn input tokens of a real codex exec before and after; verify the -c keys are accepted by codex 0.166 (web_search="disabled", features.image_generation=false) before relying on them. Note: a minimal codex exec hung for 10+ minutes under host load 13 on 2026-10-31; measure with a timeout.
